comment: Reconciles every refusal site in the agent-skills gate family against the control that trips it, bidirectionally — see scripts/check-refusal-coverage.mjs. A site with no entry, an entry with no site, and an entry naming a test that no longer exists all fail the checker. An 'accepted' entry is the reviewed ledger for a refusal no control trips, with the reason it is accepted.

antigravity-root-required.accepted: The demo fixture registry models no Antigravity target; tripping this requires an antigravity-target fixture family the drivers suite does not yet have. Candidate for a future control.

target-not-declared-tree.control: build refuses publishing into a path that is not a declared skills tree

target-renders-nothing.accepted: Requires a platform target that every fixture skill excludes via front-config; the demo templates carry no front-config. Candidate for a future control alongside a front-config fixture.

undeclared-skill-on-disk.control: build refuses a skills-src directory the registry does not declare, naming the missing entrypoint

declared-skill-missing.control: build refuses a registry skill with no directory on disk

entrypoint-not-eta.control: build refuses a declared skill whose entrypoint is a plain SKILL.md

no-template-for-rendered-file.control: untracked guard diagnoses each file before advising, without a stack trace

untracked-in-target-tree.control: freshness gate turns red on new untracked render output

registry-guard-refused.control: build refuses a registry skill with no directory on disk

no-marker-syntax.accepted: Tripping it requires the CLI to render a file type injectMarker() does not know, which the fixture CLI stubs cannot produce without also failing render verification first. Candidate for a future control.

git-diff-failed.accepted: Infrastructure refusal: git itself failing inside a valid repository is not reproducible hermetically without breaking every other assertion in the same fixture.

would-destroy-hand-edit.control: build restores and refuses a hand-edited rendered file, naming its template

verification-failures.control: build fails when the CLI reports some targets but not all

no-verifiable-render.control: build fails closed when the CLI exits 0 having written nothing

derivation-source-unreadable.control: hooks gate refuses an unreadable derivation source

wrapper-script-unparseable.control: hooks gate refuses a wrapper script it cannot replay

build-script-unparseable.control: hooks gate refuses a build script whose output flags cannot be parsed

build-writes-outside-repo.control: hooks gate refuses a build destination outside the repository

replay-failed.control: hooks gate refuses a build whose scratch replay fails

replay-wrote-nothing.control: hooks gate refuses a build that exits 0 having written nothing

empty-derivation.control: hooks gate refuses an empty derivation when no build scripts exist

platform-reconciliation.control: hooks gate goes red when a platform build script is removed from the derivation source

derived-tree-missing.control: hooks gate goes red when a build destination is renamed away from the committed tree

git-status-failed.accepted: Infrastructure refusal: git status failing inside a valid repository is not reproducible hermetically.

stale-trees.control: freshness gate detects committed drift and advises committing the rebuilt trees

usage.accepted: Argument-validation refusal on the gate's own CLI surface; every caller is the shared gate set, which passes a literal suite name.

hand-edit-in-trees.control: freshness gate routes a hand-edit to the template, preserving the edited bytes

no-verifiable-render.control: freshness gate never advises committing when the render did not verifiably run

build-refused.control: freshness gate turns red on new untracked render output

unterminated-region.control: vocab sync refuses a region without a matching END marker

no-regions.control: vocab sync refuses a template tree with no vocab regions at all

stale-regions.control: vocab sync --check turns red on a stale region

registry-guard-refused.accepted: Shares assertSafeTargets with the build path, whose emission channel is policed by the target-tree control; a lint-path duplicate would re-test the same registry throw through an identical catch-print-exit channel.

cli-no-version.control: lint refuses a CLI that produces no version output at all

aggregate-failures.control: lint distinguishes "reported nothing at all" from "these sites are now clean"
